title: Privacy Policy
metaDescription: Our privacy commitments: zero personal data logging, local browser storage for API keys, and privacy-by-default video processing.
content:
## Privacy Policy

**Last updated: October 19, 2026**

### 1. Zero Personal Data Collection

YouTube Summarizer is designed with privacy-by-default. We do not require account registration, email addresses, credit cards, or passwords to use the core video summarizer.

### 2. Client-Side API Key Storage

Any custom API keys you enter in the Settings modal (such as OpenRouter keys) are stored purely on your local device via browser `localStorage`. They are never sent to or logged on our permanent database servers.

### 3. YouTube Data Processing

When you submit a video URL, our serverless API retrieves public subtitles and metadata using YouTube's standard protocols solely to generate the requested summary. We do not store or sell your search history.

### 4. Cookies

We use a single HTTP-only session cookie only when accessing the `/admin` console. No tracking or analytics cookies are used.

### 5. Contact

For privacy-related inquiries, please contact us at privacy@youtube-summarizer.app.

We reserve the right to update these terms at any time. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of updated terms.

metaDescription: Step-by-step guide on extracting video transcripts and generating instant AI takeaways from any YouTube video.
content:
## How to Use YouTube Summarizer

Get instant AI-powered summaries from any YouTube video in just a few steps.

### Step 1: Copy a YouTube URL

Find any YouTube video you want to summarize. Copy the full URL from your browser address bar (e.g., `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ`).

### Step 2: Paste the URL

Paste the copied URL into the input field on the [YouTube Summarizer homepage](/) and click **Summarize Video**.

### Step 3: Wait 1-2 Seconds

The transcript is fetched instantly. The AI summary generates in the background — you can read the raw transcript immediately while it processes.

### Step 4: Explore the Results

- **Transcript tab**: Full timestamped captions you can search and copy.
- **Key Takeaways**: 5-10 bullet points of the most important insights.
- **Chapters**: Timestamped chapter breakdown with mini-summaries.
- **Full Summary**: A structured article-style deep summary.
- **Infographic**: Visual stat cards and memorable quotes.
- **Chat**: Ask any question about the video content.

### Step 5: Configure Your AI Model (Optional)

Click the **Settings** gear icon in the top navigation to switch between Google Gemini (default, free) and OpenRouter models.

content:
## About YouTube Summarizer

### Our Mission

We believe that knowledge trapped inside long YouTube videos should be instantly accessible to everyone. YouTube Summarizer was built to eliminate the friction between you and the insights you need.

### What We Do

We use state-of-the-art large language models (Google Gemini, Meta Llama via OpenRouter) to:

- Extract full timestamped transcripts in under 2 seconds
- Generate structured key takeaways and chapter breakdowns
- Create visual infographic summaries
- Enable interactive Q&A chat with any video

### Free & Privacy-First

The core tool is completely free with no signup required. We are committed to never storing or selling your usage data. API keys are saved only in your browser's local storage.

### Powered By

Our AI pipeline is powered by **Cody**, built with love using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Google Gemini AI, and OpenRouter's open model ecosystem.

[Start summarizing videos for free →](/)
